newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Randgold Resources may list next year.
newsitem.headline: Randgold Resources may list next year.

text.p: Randgold Resources, the exploration and new business unit of Randgold and Exploration Company Ltd, may list on a major stock exchange early next year, a company spokesman told Reuters on Tuesday.
"We are on track to list by the end of the first quarter of 1998. We said that in our last quarterly presentation and we are still on track for that," spokesman Adrian Reynolds said.

The company said on Monday at the release of results for the three months to December it had defined a resource base of nine million ounces in four countries and was evaluating several new discoveries.
The company, which is active in west and central Africa, said this followed the takeover of BHP Minerals Mali, including the Syama Gold Mine, its first gold mine, in October last year.
The takeover of the BHP unit had proceeded smoothly and the potential value of the other assets acquired from BHP confirmed, Randgold Resources said.
